messages:
elaine: Quick sync — Novum Bank POC hit a blocker. IdP team says domain verification step is failing during SAML metadata upload. Can we run through the minimal steps they need for tenant verification?

sanjay: Which step specifically? TXT record? Or are they stuck on the cert / entityID?

elaine: They see 400 when we post their SAML metadata to /v1/saml/metadata and the UI shows 'domain not verified'. We asked for DNS TXT but they expected email-based verification.

olivia: We support both, but email verification is only for consumer accounts. For enterprise/private deployments we require DNS TXT ownership or HTTP file proof. Need the exact TXT value: `_redwood-verification=nb-prod-<org_id>`

ben: I'll ping their infra contact with the TXT and a one-liner curl to verify quickly: `dig +short TXT _redwood-verification.example.com` — that usually clears up confusion.

elaine: Thanks. Also question from procurement: will SCIM provisioning be charged separately during the POC? They asked if SCIM calls count against API token usage.

olivia: SCIM provisioning calls are not billed as token-generation usage. They are accounted as management API calls and fall under control-plane operations (no per-token charge). For Dedicated customers we include basic SCIM in the tier; for enterprise Private there may be an integration/setup fee — see pricing note.

security: Side note: they requested that group-to-role mapping be enforced by us (RBAC mapping), and they want a mapping audit log exported to their SIEM. Feasible?

ben: Yes — we support mapping rules like `idp_group:RedwoodRole` via the console or SCIM patch rules. Audit events can be exported via our syslog/HTTP webhook connector (activity.user.role_change event). Provide retention SLA?

security: They want 12 months retention on audit and an HMAC-signed webhook payload. We can support 12 months on Enterprise add-on. HMAC signing is supported (header X-RW-Signature).

elaine: Practical POC asks: 1) provide TXT verification value 2) send sample SAML metadata upload command 3) give them a short RBAC mapping example and 4) confirm SCIM behavior for deprovision vs. disable.

olivia: SCIM behavior: we honor `active` flag on Users (RFC7644). A DELETE from IdP will deprovision (remove), while `PATCH active:false` will disable but keep history. We'll include the exact JSON snippets.

elaine: Can someone drop the minimal commands/snippets here so I can forward to Novum? Also if infra-bot can create a temporary POC workspace with explicit 30-day expiry that'd be ideal.

infra-bot: POC workspace `novum-poc-1834` created with expiry 2025-12-15T00:00:00Z. Invite link: https://console.redwood.ai/p/novum-poc-1834/invite (rotating).

ben: Snippets below — feel free to paste.

ben: SAML metadata upload (curl):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -F "metadata=@/path/to/novum-metadata.xml" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/saml/metadata
```

ben: DNS TXT value: `_redwood-verification=nb-prod-1834` (replace domain).

ben: RBAC mapping example (console JSON rule):
```
{
  "rule_name": "novum-admins",
  "idp_group": "Novum-Admins",
  "redwood_role": "org_admin",
  "priority": 100
}
```

ben: SCIM deprovision example (PATCH disable):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/12345
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "value": {"active": false}}
  ]
}
```

olivia: Add to that: if they send `DELETE /scim/v2/Users/12345` we will remove the user and emit `user.deleted` audit event.

elaine: Perfect. Final ask from sales: can we get a short note on commercial impact if they want SCIM provisioning across 10k users during pilot (rough guesstimate)? They need to justify infra during procurement.

ben: For pilot scale 10k users: control-plane SCIM ops are negligible cost relative to token spend. If they plan to do bulk synces nightly, recommend batching and our suggested rate-limit settings; cost impact mainly on their IdP and network egress. I'll write a 1-paragraph estimate for procurement.

elaine: Great. I'll forward these snippets and the POC workspace link. I'll follow up if Novum hits another blocker. :thumbsup:
